name: DST London: weekly Friday 09:00 across the last-Sunday-of-March change
note: Europe/London moves from GMT to BST on Sunday 2026-03-29 at 01:00Z. Fridays Mar 20 and Mar 27 are GMT, so 09:00 local is 09:00Z. Friday Apr 3 is BST (UTC+1), so 09:00 local is 08:00Z. The local hour is preserved and the UTC instant moves one hour earlier.
